warnings: PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json.

EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented.

The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank.
Closes หมวดงานโครงสร้าง, which opened on แผ่นที่ 2/34.

*** THE STEEL SCHEDULE (1.10 งานเหล็กรูปพรรณ) RECONCILES ALMOST PERFECTLY WITH THE STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS. *** All seven sections appear in the S sheets: 150x75x25x3.2 @8.27 kg/m is BS1/CS1 and the S-06 rafter; 125x65x6x8 @13.4 is the S-06 ridge/hip/valley; 125x50x20x3.2 @6.13 is CS2 and the S-05 ridge; 150x75x9x12.5 @24.00 is the S-04 terrace rafter and the DETAIL 1-3 channel; 100x50x20x2.3 @4.06 is the S-05 rafter and hip; 100x50x20x3.2 @5.50 is the S-04 purlin; 75x45x15x2.3 @3.25 is the S-05 purlin. The unit weights match the drawings' หมายเหตุ blocks EXACTLY, which is a strong cross-check on both.

THE PLATES AND BOLTS ALSO MATCH S-15: PL 12 มม. is the 300x200x12 and 200x200x12 base plates of DETAIL 1-3, PL 9 มม. is the 100x100x9 and 200x200x9 plates of ขยาย "1", and BOLT ø16 x 0.30 ม. x 24 ชุด is exactly the '4-Ø16 ล้วงลึกลงเสายาว 0.30 ม.' bolt group -- 24 bolts = 6 joints x 4, and S-04 marks exactly 6 joint callouts (DETAIL 1 x4, DETAIL 2 x1, DETAIL 3 x1).

The steel-section glyph printed before each dimension string is a channel-profile symbol; it is transcribed as '[' and flagged section_glyph_transcribed_as_bracket rather than guessed at, following the precedent set in house 05's BOQ.
ทาสีกันสนิม 291 ตร.ม. is the anti-rust painting of all that steelwork -- an area item with no drawing equivalent.
The รวมข้อ 1 subtotal row is blank like every other price cell.
